name: Anchors of identities barred from swarm alpha

management.authority: A single account. It chooses the source and the relation; it does not choose members.

purpose.statement: Lets an adopter extend the refusal of an identity to the account bound to it, if the adopter decides to

basis.statement: Membership is derived at every request from the source list and the relation.
basis.source: Barred from swarm alpha (DENY, ENUMERATED), followed at its latest state

time.validity: While the origin is listed and the relation holds

dueProcess.objection: An objection is directed at the entry of the origin in the source list.
